text:
Situation: Calcium gluconate 98 mg/mL 10 mL vials are not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The earlier shortage first posted on 2021-03-24 has been resolved. Corvale East holds two lots totaling 866 vials with 34.5 days on hand at 25.1 vials per day. Corvale General holds 382 vials with 28.9 days on hand at 13.2 vials per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show calcium gluconate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2021-03-24 has been resolved. No public FDA signal exists at the plants for the recommended alternate manufacturer Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-10-13, and HP Halden Pharma AS was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-05-10.

Our position: Current inventory supports continued supply without emergency measures. The top-ranked alternate manufacturer Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is not on FDA's shortage list and its associated plants have recent VAI inspections. Next alternatives B. Braun Medical Inc. and Caplin Steriles Limited are also not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from current contracted suppliers (buyer approves).
2. Qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a backup source and place a test order if contract terms allow (buyer approves; P&T committee approves formulary addition if needed).
3. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any new posting to the committee (buyer approves).

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or conservation protocols at this time.
